title: Compound nouns and -daky
summary: Name kinds of things with noun compounds (*awtobus duralgasy*, *türkmen halysy*, *Magtymguly köçesi*) and put **my** or a case ending on them (*mekdep sumkam*, *duralgasynda*), pick things out by place and time with `-dAky` and `-ky` (*öýdäki kitap*, *şu günki gazet*, *soňky awtobus*), and say **mine**, **yours** and **whose** with *meniňki*, *seniňki*, *kimiňki*.
canDo: Name places in town, dishes and drinks with two-noun compounds
Give your phone number and talk about your things: my school bag, our room number
Pick things out by where and when they are: the book at home, today's paper, the last bus
Ask whose something is and answer: mine, yours, my father's
